ref_text: THOSE PRETTY WRONGS THAT LIBERTY COMMITS WHEN I AM SOMETIME ABSENT FROM THY HEART THY BEAUTY AND THY YEARS FULL WELL BEFITS FOR STILL TEMPTATION FOLLOWS WHERE THOU ART
text: Those pretty wrongs that liberty commits. When I am sometime absent from thy heart, thy beauty, and thy years fall well-bifits, for still temptation follows where thou art.
